author: Antonialock
body:
Thanks Val.

There are a lot of MGI and HGNU annotations for mouse and human DPM1 to "GPI anchor biosynthetic process", I disputed these. In case not all annotations are fixed for mouse/human I also added an IDA to bovine to "dolichol phosphate mannose biosynthetic process" so this will act as a negative entry for the wrong "glycerophospholipid biosynthetic process" (swiss-prot entries need to agree on the annotation for arba to propagate it).

I also found IMP evidence for the pombe protein in 18355438 fig 4 II A/B so I added that + curated the plasmodium entry. Belts and braces! Hopefully this should be enough to remove the wrong annotation. I will check back. 

example entries to check:
O14466 Q9WU83 A5GFZ5 Q54LP3

note to self:
weirdly ARBA annotates Craniata with GPI anchor biosynthetic process (via ARBA00026293), but other organisms with the less specific dolichol phosphate mannose biosynthetic process (via ARBA00028351). I have asked the developers why this is, I can't see an obvious reason.
